aHoldIsNotAVerdict: Nothing here is a review outcome. No reviewer has seen these artifacts and none is assigned. The status records that the captain will not build a review base from these commits, and why.

denominatorUnmoved.because: a held batch changes no asset's disposition; the families in it stay exactly where the queue already puts them.

holds.heldBy: Session 1 (integration captain), on Session 10's measured findings

commits.subject: feat(rcap-pdf): lane 2 batch 01 — six KY/NE families rerendered from official bytes
Fill every evidence slot in the lane-2 batch-01 sidecars from current bytes
Mutate the two visual proofs this verifier owns

defects.finding: 34 opaque white rectangles cover official source content on the finalized artifacts
defects.whyItBlocksReview: A reviewer reading the finalized page cannot see what the rectangles hide, so an approval would attest to a page whose official content is obscured rather than absent.

defects.finding: flattened chooser prompts, command buttons and option-list residue reach the filed page
defects.whyItBlocksReview: Interface text on a filed pleading is a defect a reviewer would return, and it is already known; the return would tell this programme nothing it does not have.

holds.sidecarsAreNotLaunchEvidence: Session 9's sidecars are pinned to artifacts that must be replaced. They are not imported as current launch evidence, because a sidecar is a claim about specific bytes and those bytes are scheduled for replacement; importing them would put a conformant-looking record against files that will not exist.
